about.heading: Mr Night [full name]
about.subheading: Founder and Private Driver · 15 years' experience as a guide in Siem Reap · Speaks English, Thai and Khmer
story: My name is Night, but my guests call me Mr Night. I was born and grew up in Cambodia, and my family survived the Khmer Rouge years. As a young man I trained as a Buddhist monk, and it was my dream to become one. But my father died young, so I left the monastery to work and take care of my mother.

That is how I started in tourism. For 15 years I have worked as a guide in Siem Reap, sharing the temples of Angkor, our villages and our Khmer culture with visitors from all over the world. Today my mother still lives with me, and I am a proud father of two young boys. Everything I earn supports my family.

Now I drive my own Toyota Alphard, with reclining massage seats, cool air-con, cold water and cold towels, so you can relax between the temples. I know Siem Reap like my home, because it is my home. When you travel with me, you are not a customer, you are my guest.
Message me on WhatsApp any time. I look forward to showing you my Cambodia.

faq.q: How far is the new airport?
faq.a: Siem Reap Angkor International Airport (SAI) is about 50 km from town, about 1 hour by van. Send me your flight number and I will watch for delays.
A private luxury van (Toyota Alphard) with reclining massage seats, strong air-con, cold water and cold towels.
No. Transfer and tour prices are for the whole van.

faq.q: Do you guide inside the temples?
faq.a: No. I am a driver. Only licensed guides can guide inside the temples, and I can book one for you.
Send me a WhatsApp message with your dates, number of people and hotel. I will reply with the price.

faq.q: Do I need an Angkor Pass?
faq.a: Yes. Buy it at the official ticket office or at angkorenterprise.gov.kh. It is not included in the van price.

faq.q: I'm in Bangkok. Can I come by land?
faq.a: Please message me to check the current border status first. You can also fly from Bangkok to Siem Reap (about 1 hour) and I will meet you at SAI airport.
